text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While researching in the library after school,
Mejiro Ardan walked in.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
choice_data_list: Are you okay? Did you get dizzy?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Yes... Thank you kindly...
I'll be fine, I'm used to it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: More importantly, I need to check out the next volume of the book.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, here it is. *Twinkle Series Data Bible*, Volume 28.
choice_data_list: Impressive... You read the entire series?
Impressive... You read the entire series?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Yes. I was reading it on a day I wasn't feeling so great, and before I knew it...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...My body can't handle overexertion, so I thought I could learn from history instead...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I simply want to do everything I can.
...For the day I shine on the racetrack.
choice_data_list: You're putting in effort even while you can't practice on the track.
You still work hard even when you can't practice, huh?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
No, no, it's really nothing.
I'm only doing it because I want to.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right... Aside from training books,
is there anything else you'd recommend as a reference?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If your body isn't very resilient, there should be a perfect
book for you. If I recall, the title was――
choice_data_list: "Restful Sleep Tips to Rewire Your Brain"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: A recipe book...! How lovely. I am quite interested in healthy, nourishing dishes.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Despite how I might look, I'm actually quite good at cooking, you know♪
My governess taught me well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I'll borrow this and take it home today. If I review my nutritional intake, I can get even stronger...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She offered a gentle smile
and gallantly set off in search of the books.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: I see... Precisely because I have more days off than most, how I spend my rest is crucial.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's splendid insight as expected.
I'll read it right away and put it into practice tonight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
This will surely improve the quality of her sleep.
Her physical condition is bound to get better as well.
